posts.text:
What happened to  Newport Beach last night?

400 arrested, ton of fights, fireworks thrown at crowds + police during 4th of July celebration.

This is supposed to be one of the wealthiest & safest cities in America.

It’s a shame!

Celebrate the 4th but we gotta protect our own.
posts.summary: Criticizes chaos and violence at Newport Beach Fourth of July celebration

posts.text:
Happy 250th birthday to the GREATEST country in the world. 🇺🇸 

We won’t always agree on politics nor see the world the same way.

But today is about celebrating the country that gives us the freedom to disagree.

Major respect to the founding fathers. 🫡 

Future looks bright!
